title: The sound of Willie's slide trombone and the Zulu band
summary: A woman missed the big slide trombone player; Willie and Warner led off and the band was recognizable blocks away.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah, and I just fixed it and said the pavement. Well, that's where the Zulus was, right there. All of them used to go there. I have a picture of that place. Yeah, all of them used to go there. Well, my husband and them had their band. They used to be white people come from the north and take their band, take my husband and them's pictures, you know, in the band. Yeah, they used to take it and carry it. Last time I went out there, I had some children. I was mining for a lady. And the lady asked me, oh, she said, where is the big man? Used to play the sliding trampone and went, ooh, that woman filled me up. I said, who are you? She said, I'm talking to you, lady. I said, oh, he died. Oh, she said, that band ain't like it used to be when he played. Show you the difference how she could tell, eh? Well, he was the one done the playing, you see, the slide. The slide was the one that would start off, you know. That's why. Right up in front. Well, he'd be in the front of him and Warner, and they would start the playing, you see. And when they start the playing, then the others would come right on in. And show you how she knows. She said, well, the other players said, we come with on here. She said, oh, we want to take the pitch. Oh, she said, the Zulus ain't like it used to be. I said, no, ma'am. I said, well, that big man, he's dead. That's my husband. She said, oh. She said, what a pity. And I'll show you how they noticed things. Oh, he's a good player. You got to give it to him. Yes, ma'am. They had a good band. And you could tell that band anywhere. I could be in my house, and I could tell that band anywhere. It could be four, five, six blocks. I could tell that band when they be coming. You could tell it. But just now it was good. I could tell them. Oh, they ain't like that no more. Uh-uh.
